tool_input.command:
cd "$(pwd)"; 
# Build combined file: header + all data rows from both files
head -1 data/transactions_export_1.csv > .tmp/combined.csv
tail -n +2 data/transactions_export_1.csv >> .tmp/combined.csv
tail -n +2 data/transactions_export_2.csv >> .tmp/combined.csv
echo "combined data rows (incl dupes): $(($(wc -l < .tmp/combined.csv) - 1))"
echo "unique row_ids in combined: $(tail -n +2 .tmp/combined.csv | cut -d, -f1 | sort -u | wc -l)"
# verify overlapping rows are identical re-deliveries
comm -12 .tmp/ids1.txt .tmp/ids2.txt > .tmp/overlap_ids.txt
mismatch=0
while read id; do
  r1=$(grep "^$id," data/transactions_export_1.csv)
  r2=$(grep "^$id," data/transactions_export_2.csv)
  if [ "$r1" != "$r2" ]; then mismatch=$((mismatch+1)); fi
done < .tmp/overlap_ids.txt
echo "overlapping rows with mismatched content: $mismatch"
tool_input.description: Build combined CSV and verify overlap rows are identical
